title: Enabling Classifiers to Make Judgements Explicitly Aligned with Human Values
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the ability of models to perform value-aligned sexism classification. One of the specific value categories was 'Religion-based sexism', which involved classifying content as sexist or non-sexist based on values concerning discrimination or prejudice stemming from religious scriptures or constructs.
findings: In the per-category performance evaluation, the fine-tuned VA-BART model demonstrated high performance on the 'Religion-based sexism' category, achieving both accuracy and a weighted F1-score of over 90%.
